title: TikTok and iHeartPodcasts Announce Three New Podcasts Joining the TikTok Podcast Network This Fall
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
***“Oh My Kosh with Hannah Kosh,” “Born to Become with Diana Flores” and “Caroline’s Closet” Join the Network’s Growing Slate of Original Podcasts From Leading Voices Across Internet Culture, Sports and Fashion***


***Listen to the “Oh My Kosh with Hannah Kosh” trailer now***[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-oh-my-kosh-with-hannah-ko-347963735) ******


**NEW YORK — October 21, 2026 —** TikTok and iHeartPodcasts, the No. 1 podcast publisher globally according to[Podtrac](https://analytics.podtrac.com/podcast-publisher-rankings) , today announced three original podcasts joining the[TikTok Podcast Network](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktokpodcastnetwork) this fall. The new additions include “Oh My Kosh with Hannah Kosh,” hosted by creator and self-proclaimed internet historian[Hannah Kosh](https://www.tiktok.com/@hannahkosh) ; “Born to Become with Diana Flores,” hosted by two-time flag football world champion and NFL and International Federation of American Football (IFAF) Global Flag Ambassador[Diana Flores](https://www.tiktok.com/@dianaflres33?lang=en) ; and “Caroline’s Closet,” hosted by fashion editor, author and personality[Caroline Vazzana](https://www.tiktok.com/@cvazzana?lang=en) .


The three new series will expand the TikTok Podcast Network’s growing slate of original programming with distinct voices and formats spanning internet culture, sports and fashion. The new additions reflect TikTok and iHeart’s continued focus on creating new opportunities for creators to grow and reach new audiences, while giving fans more ways to discover and connect with the personalities they love.


The fall lineup additions include:


**“OH MY KOSH WITH HANNAH KOSH” — PREMIERES OCTOBER 28**
***Trailer Available Now | Listen***[HERE](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-oh-my-kosh-with-hannah-ko-347963735)


Hosted by creator and self-proclaimed internet historian Hannah Kosh, “Oh My Kosh with Hannah Kosh” will be a weekly deep dive into the stories behind the scroll. Each week, Hannah will unpack the headlines, trends and conversations taking over the internet — from micro-trends and influencer relationships to surprise album drops, movie premieres and more. Bringing journalistic curiosity and a sense of humor to the topics dominating feeds, Hannah will provide context and perspective on the internet stories everyone is talking about. “Oh My Kosh with Hannah Kosh” debuts October 28, 2026, with new episodes dropping on Wednesdays.


"This is a dream partnership and I'm so excited to bring to life with TikTok and iHeart,” said Kosh. “I love everything they're doing and feel so honored to be a part of it. Oh My Kosh is a show that I've dreamt of for years and I can't wait for everyone to listen!"


**“BORN TO BECOME WITH DIANA FLORES” — PREMIERES NOVEMBER 5**


Hosted by Diana Flores, two-time flag football world champion, NFL and IFAF Global Flag Ambassador, and quarterback and captain of Mexico’s national flag football team, “Born to Become with Diana Flores” will feature leading voices across sports, entertainment, business and culture for candid conversations that go beyond their professional accolades to reveal the people behind the achievements. Drawing on her own journey breaking barriers and helping elevate flag football on the global stage, Flores will sit down each week with athletes, executives, innovators, entrepreneurs, artists, creators and more to explore the defining experiences, challenges and turning points that have shaped who they are today. Through honest, fun and raw conversations, “Born to Become” will uncover the personal stories often left out of professional bios, offering listeners new perspectives and lessons they can apply to their own lives. “Born to Become with Diana Flores” will debut November 5, 2026, with new episodes dropping on Thursdays.


“Throughout my journey as an athlete and NFL and IFAF Global Flag Ambassador, I’ve learned that who we become is shaped by so much more than our accomplishments,” said Flores. “It’s the challenges we overcome, the people who believe in us, the risks we take, and the moments that push us beyond what we thought was possible. Growing up, I never could have imagined where this journey would take me, and that’s what makes the stories behind success so powerful. With “Born to Become,” I’m excited to partner with TikTok and iHeartPodcasts to have honest, meaningful conversations that go beyond the headlines and explore the experiences that shape who we are. My hope is that listeners see a piece of themselves in these stories and walk away inspired to dream bigger, embrace their own journeys, and realize that who they can become has no limits.”


**“CAROLINE’S CLOSET” — PREMIERES DECEMBER 10**


Hosted by fashion editor, author and personality Caroline Vazzana, “Caroline’s Closet” will be a new interview series exploring the role fashion plays in shaping identity. In each episode, Vazzana will meet with guests inside their closets for personal conversations about their style, the stories behind what they wear and the ways fashion has influenced their lives. “Caroline’s Closet” is set to launch December 10, 2026, with new episodes dropping on Thursdays.


"I am so excited to launch Caroline’s Closet with iHeart,” said Vazzana. “Growing up, I always dreamed of working in fashion, and being able to share my love of personal style, bold colors, and maximalist fashion with the world has been a dream come true. Now, I can't wait to step inside the closets of some truly inspiring people and discover the stories, memories, and personalities behind what they wear. Because I've always believed that fashion should be fun, personal, and a little unexpected. After all, life is too short to wear boring clothes!”


“These new shows bring distinct voices to the TikTok Podcast Network as we continue to expand the range of original programming available to listeners and viewers,” said Will Pearson, President of iHeartPodcasts. “From sports to internet culture and fashion, Diana, Hannah and Caroline each bring their own fresh perspective and engaged following, creating new opportunities for listeners to go deeper into the stories, conversations and communities they care about.”


"TikTok is where audiences discover what’s next, and we’re dedicated to building partnerships that help creators unlock new audiences and extend their voices beyond the feed. We’re thrilled to bring Hannah, Diana, and Caroline to the TikTok Podcast Network so they can deepen their connection with fans and grow as both storytellers and entrepreneurs. Together with iHeart, we’re turning digital discovery into lasting, sustainable opportunities for these incredible voices," said Dan Page, Global Head of Global Media and Licensing Partnerships at TikTok.


[Launched in March 2026](https://www.iheartmedia.com/press/iheartmedia-and-tiktok-announce-launch-tiktok-radio-and-inaugural-line-creator-hosts-tiktok) , the TikTok Podcast Network is a first-of-its-kind partnership between TikTok and iHeartMedia that brings some of the platform’s leading creators into long-form podcasting. Designed to expand creator storytelling beyond short-form video, the network combines TikTok’s creator ecosystem with iHeartMedia’s industry-leading podcast production, publishing and monetization capabilities. GEICO serves as the network’s exclusive launch partner, creating new opportunities for brands to engage audiences through creator-led podcast content. The slate also includes “[Sports Slice](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-sports-slice-330155745/) ” hosted by sports creator[Tim Martin](https://www.tiktok.com/@timbosliceoflife12) ; “[The Clifford Show](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-the-clifford-show-330047416/) ” hosted by former college football player turned sports creator[Clifford Taylor IV](https://www.tiktok.com/@clifford) ; “[Suite 305 with Lele Pons](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-suite-305-with-lele-pons-336591965/) ” hosted by multihyphenate and social media star[Lele Pons](https://www.tiktok.com/@lelepons) ; and “[Delivering Happiness](https://www.iheart.com/podcast/1119-delivering-happiness-with-337532701) ” hosted by actor[Nick Turturro](https://www.tiktok.com/@nickturturro?lang=en) . All podcasts on the TikTok Podcast Network are published by iHeartPodcasts and are available on the[iHeartRadio app](https://www.iheart.com/) and everywhere podcasts are heard. Clips, highlights and behind-the-scenes moments from the shows will also be featured across TikTok and posted on the[TikTok Podcast Network](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktokpodcastnetwork) official account.

**About Hannah Kosh**


Hannah Kosh is a social media commentator and entertainment personality known for spilling the latest tea on pop culture, the influencer world, and sports. Often described as a blend of Gossip Girl, Andy Cohen, and Sporty Spice, Hannah’s engaging mix of humor and sharp insight keeps her audience hooked. With a personality that shines through every post, her content reaches millions across multiple digital platforms, drawing fans back daily for her witty commentary and unique perspective. Hannah earned her Master's in Sports Management from the University of San Francisco. Before transitioning to a full-time creator, she built a strong foundation in public relations and social media, working with some of San Diego's most prominent sports teams, including the San Diego Seals and the San Diego Padres.


**About Diana Flores**


Diana Flores is captain and quarterback of Mexico’s National Flag Football Team, an ambassador for both the NFL and the International Federation of American Football (IFAF), and a global champion of flag football’s historic growth. She led Mexico to a gold medal at the 2022 and 2025 World Games, and most recently captained the team to Olympic qualification for the LA 2028 Games, where flag football will make its historic debut. Flores was named to this year’s TIME100 Most Influential People in Sports list, cementing her status as one of the most impactful athletes in the world. She was honored as the 2025 “Re-Writing the Game” Award recipient by the Women’s Sports Foundation and named to the organization’s Board of Trustees, and was recognized by Forbes in its prestigious "30 Under 30" Class of 2024. Flores also starred in the NFL’s groundbreaking “Run With It” Super Bowl ad campaign, becoming one of the most recognizable faces in flag football and inspiring a worldwide reimagining of women’s sports.


**About Caroline Vazzana**


Caroline Vazzana is a New York–based fashion creator, stylist, author, and television host known for her colorful, maximalist style and playful approach to fashion. After beginning her career in the magazine industry working at Teen Vogue and InStyle, Caroline built a digital platform that blends high fashion with storytelling, where she shares behind-the-scenes moments from Fashion Week, avant-garde styling tips, and playful fashion commentary. Whether attending runway shows, styling looks, or helping others discover their personal style, she approaches fashion with a sense of fun, optimism, and creativity that continues to resonate with audiences around the world.


**About TikTok**


TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and its offices include New York, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul and Tokyo.
